en: Fixed `/install-github-app` updating the workflow after "Skip workflow update" was chosen, running setup twice on a repeated Enter, and ↑ on the repository step blocking a typed repository name when no repository was detected
zh: 修复 `/install-github-app` 在选择了“Skip workflow update”后仍更新 workflow、重复按 Enter 时运行两次设置，以及未检测到仓库时在仓库步骤按 ↑ 阻止输入仓库名的问题
